idea-plugin.name: IJ-format
idea-plugin.description:
Format selected lines of Java or Kotlin from an MCP client using IntelliJ IDEA's native formatter.

  • Use the current IDE-wide code style, including while a project is open.
  • Send a standalone source snippet and line range to the local ij_format_lines tool.
  • Manage the loopback server, configure worker and queue limits, and copy its connection JSON from Settings > Tools > IJ-format.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Adds exact line-and-column selections, a companion Go CLI, and configurable MCP worker and queue limits.
